events.title: Marriages
events.description: Married (1) Hannah Saxton in Huntington, 1730; (2) Anna, daughter of Job Smith 2d and widow of Ebenezer Smith. Large tracts laid out to him 1736; homestead at Sunk Meadow, Smithtown. [R4-S1]

bio: Pelletreau's Platt lineage ([R4-S1]): son of Jonas Platt (b. 1684, drowned at Amboy 1731), grandson of Capt. Epenetus Platt of Huntington. Children by Hannah Saxton: Jonas, Zephaniah, Nathaniel, Charles, Hannah, Elizabeth; by Anna Smith: Jeremiah, Daniel, Sarah and Dorothea. He is an in-law (stepfather of Anna's Smith children). Important: he is NOT the Plattsburgh founder Zephaniah Platt (1735-1807); that man is his son by Hannah Saxton.

conflicts.found: Zephaniah Platt (1704-1778), father of the Plattsburgh founder Zephaniah Platt (1735-1807)
conflicts.assessment: Do not attach the Wikipedia/Commons material for the Plattsburgh founder to this person.
